temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworking and neglecting his health; a relaxing weekend retreat might help him recover and gain perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Gary's refusal confirms that his workload and sense of obligation are very strong, and that a simple invitation may not be enough to get him to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is deeply overcommitted and currently unwilling or unable to take a break, but he still needs support and intervention.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and worry, with some disappointment or frustration at Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep trying to help Gary, perhaps by persuading him again or finding another way to support his health and well-being.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When confronted, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is under significant work pressure and has been reluctant to take a break; his overwork may be about more than just hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Ethan's suspicion strengthens: Gary's overworking is likely tied to hidden personal or complicated issues, not only professional demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is hiding deeper problems and needs a nonjudgmental friend to help him open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to share what is really going on, while offering nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He explains that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork is connected to personal or complicated issues beyond professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Ethan's suspicion is confirmed and clarified; he now understands the specific professional and personal pressures Gary faces.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with real professional and personal pressure, and he needs practical help to find a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: A mix of relief and empathy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is facing real pressures but is open to help and is trying to improve his balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Ethan sees evidence that Gary is making genuine progress and that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and can achieve a healthier work-life balance with continued encouragement and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving but may still need occasional support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Ethan now believes Gary is capable of managing on his own and no longer needs close, active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary can maintain a healthy balance independently, and Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting him know he is always available if needed.
